assessment.summary: This paper is a study protocol for a household randomized controlled trial in Kenya. It describes the planned evaluation of PBO-treated ceiling nets and mentions that kdr mutation prevalence will be measured as a secondary outcome. However, as a protocol, it contains no empirical data, results, or mosquito genotypes.
exclusion_reasons: The paper is a study protocol and does not report any empirical data.
No extractable genotype data is provided.
